description: Use this when the user asks which US states suit gas-fired data center power: the Data Center Gas Index (DCGI), a per-state score. ★ DO NOT COMPARE a DCGI figure published before 2026-08-08 with one published now — they are different indices; the full record is at /api/v1/dcgi/methodology under `corrections`. A state that cannot be priced comes back verdict UNSCORED with dcgi null and an `unscored_reason`, never a placeholder score, so treat UNSCORED as absence and not as a low score. `gas_price_series` names which EIA series answered each state. Gas-fired $/MWh figures, withdrawn the same day for a separate defect, were republished 2026-09-27 under one burner-tip price rule (see get_gas_economics). Use get_gas_intelligence for pipeline, operator and parent-midstream data.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

state.description: US state abbreviation, e.g. TX, VA, AZ. Returns the DCGI score and verdict, plus `gas_price_series` naming which EIA series priced the state.

name: get_gas_index
title: Gas Index (DCGI)
